run_txt2csv: run the txt2csv script to convert nba.txt tab-delimited roster data into nba_roster.csv
refactor_txt2csv: refactor the txt2csv script to accept input and output file paths as command-line arguments
review_txt2csv: review the txt2csv script that parses tab-delimited NBA roster text and writes CSV output
summarize_txt2csv: summarize the txt2csv script which extracts team, name, jersey, and player stats from text to CSV
test_txt2csv: test the txt2csv script by running it against a sample nba.txt file and verifying CSV output
